parameters.jsCode: const b=$json.body??$json;if(b.social_affects_bms!==false)throw new Error('social_affects_bms must be false');const allowed=['valuepickr.com','substack.com'];const match=(h,d)=>h===d||h.endsWith('.'+d);const cutoff=String(b.information_cutoff??'');if(!/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(cutoff))throw new Error('Valid information_cutoff required');const admitted=[],rejected=[];const seen=new Set();for(const x of (Array.isArray(b.items)?b.items:[])){try{const u=new URL(String(x.url??''));const host=u.hostname.toLowerCase().replace(/^www\./,'');const published=String(x.published_at??'');const text=String(x.text??'').replace(/\s+/g,' ').trim().slice(0,2000);let reason='';if(u.protocol!=='https:')reason='non_https';else if(!allowed.some(d=>match(host,d)))reason='unsupported_source';else if(u.username||u.password||/\b(login|signin|private)\b/i.test(u.pathname))reason='non_public_url';else if(!published)reason='missing_publication_date';else if(published>cutoff)reason='post_cutoff';else if(!text)reason='empty_content';else if(seen.has(u.href))reason='duplicate';if(reason){rejected.push({url:u.href,reason});continue;}seen.add(u.href);admitted.push({source_id:`social-${String(admitted.length+1).padStart(3,'0')}`,url:u.href,source:match(host,'valuepickr.com')?'valuepickr':'substack',published_at:published,text,author_handle:null,retrieved_at:new Date().toISOString()});}catch{rejected.push({url:String(x.url??''),reason:'invalid_url'});}}return[{json:{ticker:String(b.ticker??'').toUpperCase(),social_affects_bms:false,items:admitted,rejected,privacy:{author_handles_stored:false,raw_text_limit:2000},quality_control:{candidate_count:(b.items??[]).length,admitted_count:admitted.length,rejected_count:rejected.length}}}];
